_note: Shared parity table for the CampaignGeoPrefill segment validators. Read by BOTH tests/unit/test_campaign_prefill.py and frontend/src/lib/campaignPrefill.test.ts so the two mirrors (backend/schemas/campaign_prefill.py and frontend/src/lib/campaignPrefill.ts) cannot drift: every input must produce the identical outcome on both sides. Semantics per case: the validator receives [input] as the segment list; expect 'skip' -> empty result, expect 'reject' -> validation error, any other value -> single-element result with that canonical code. The wire contract is STRICT (trim + lowercase + exact membership) - display-layer alias folding (heloc -> permit, space/hyphen -> underscore) is deliberately NOT part of the contract.
